a.lede: Apple soon won't need to physically access iPhones like the new Duo before updating them or checking returns.
a.title: Apple will reportedly run diagnostics on returned iPhones without opening the packaging

b.lede: The repair company iFixit released its repairability rating for Apple’s very first foldable iPhone. It comes as users report a wave of cracked-screen issues.
b.title: Some iPhone Duo Models Are Breaking. iFixit’s Teardown Might Explain Why
